description: This file defines a Java class 'ConceptReferenceTermEditor' which extends PropertyEditorSupport. The class provides methods to convert between text and ConceptReferenceTerm objects, fetching concepts via the Context service and based on their ID or UUID. It is used for editing or converting ConceptReferenceTerm objects within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceTermEditor
classes.description: A property editor class that converts String input into ConceptReferenceTerm objects and vice versa within the OpenMRS system.

methods.name: setAsText
methods.description: Converts a String (ID or UUID) to a ConceptReferenceTerm object by querying the ConceptService. If the input is a valid ID, fetches by ID; if not, attempts to fetch by UUID.

methods.name: getAsText
methods.description: Returns the string representation (ID) of the current ConceptReferenceTerm object. Returns an empty string if the current value is null.
